usageNotes: Use this endpoint to start Ceph services on a specific cluster node — either all services at once (default `ceph.target`) or a single named service such as a monitor, OSD, MDS, or manager. The calling principal requires `Sys.Modify` on `/`. Returns a task UPID string; poll the task endpoint to confirm the service reaches a running state before proceeding with dependent operations.

examples.summary: Start all Ceph services on node pve1 (default target)

tips: Omitting the `service` parameter starts the `ceph.target` systemd unit, which brings up all Ceph daemons on the node in dependency order — safest for a full node restart.
To start only a specific OSD (e.g., osd.2), set service to `osd.2`; use `mon.<id>`, `mds.<id>`, or `mgr.<id>` for other daemon types.
The returned string is a UPID; use get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to confirm the service started successfully before running workloads.
The node must be online and reachable by the Proxmox API; if the node is unreachable, the call will fail before a task is even queued.
